text: deepseek-harness-jev 将 Jev/System One 智能体工作流接入 DeepSeek Harness，支持智能体选择与监督、过程修正、工具输出过滤和审批。它与 DSH 原生工具协作，按配置管理运行阶段和输出准入，帮助用户在主模型继续规划与调用工具的同时引入受控的智能体协作流程。适合希望为 DSH 增加可监督、可调整的 agent 执行机制的用户。

@dsh-jev/plugin README · deepseek-harness-jev：English | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) | [中文功能与实测网站](https://luobosibing2.github.io/dsh-jev-plugin/)

**Native DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin with Jev or Luna Decisions as its judgment model.**

@dsh-jev/plugin README · deepseek-harness-jev：`deepseek-harness-jev` connects [DeepSeek Harness (DSH)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) to [Jev by TypeSafe AI](https://typesafe.ai/) for agent skill and file selection, task supervision, shared-finding corrections, tool-output filtering, single-operation approval assistance, and historical stage navigation. Its 12 features are individually configurable from one Jev settings page and are all disabled by default.

@dsh-jev/plugin README · deepseek-harness-jev：The main model continues to plan, generate answers, and call native tools. Enabled features use the saved Jev or Luna Decisions connection at DSH extension points for skill catalogs, agent lifecycle, tool results, and approvals, then apply results according to each feature. DSH configures the main model separately. Integration uses public Cordis / DSH plugin APIs without modifying the host source.

@dsh-jev/plugin README · deepseek-harness-jev：This is an independent community project, not an official DeepSeek or Jev release. It is an early-stage plugin with a bounded [DSH compatibility range](#install-through-the-web-ui-recommended); its APIs and model judgments are not a correctness guarantee.

The [Chinese feature website](https://luobosibing2.github.io/dsh-jev-plugin/) explains each DSH integration point, the information sent to the judgment service, and the observed test cases and limits.

@dsh-jev/plugin README · deepseek-harness-jev：The Chinese [principles and all features explainer](https://luobosibing2.github.io/dsh-jev-plugin/explainers/dsh-jev-plugin.html) covers all 12 features and includes a complete skill-selection input/output example. Its [Markdown source](docs/explainers/dsh-jev-plugin.md) is maintained in this repository.

@dsh-jev/plugin README · deepseek-harness-jev：The [quick review directory](https://luobosibing2.github.io/dsh-jev-plugin/#quick-review) links to short source guides. The Chinese [log-admission interview guide](https://luobosibing2.github.io/dsh-jev-plugin/explainers/log-admission-interview.html) covers generic and test logs, design choices, live-model results and their limits; its [Markdown source](docs/explainers/log-admission-interview.md) is kept here.

@dsh-jev/plugin README · deepseek-harness-jev：The Chinese [Goal supervision and completion review](https://luobosibing2.github.io/dsh-jev-plugin/explainers/goal-completion-review.html) follows the two current flows from their hooks through judgments, adoption, limited supplements and delivery records. Its [Markdown source](docs/explainers/goal-completion-review.md) separates current behavior from historical live-model results.

@dsh-jev/plugin README · deepseek-harness-jev：`main` supports Jev and Luna Decisions through OpenRouter or OpenAI, with three separate saved connections per profile. The [2026-10-07 public report](docs/testing/2026-10-07-luna-decisions/README.md) separates fixed protocol/installation checks, controlled live samples, and real DeepSeek Flash tasks. Official OpenAI calls succeeded in these limited samples; the only live OpenRouter diagnostic returned a provider-access HTTP 403 and was stopped. These results do not establish general judgment accuracy or stable task benefit.

@dsh-jev/plugin README · deepseek-harness-jev：The [2026-10-09–10 Harness compatibility report](docs/testing/2026-10-09-harness-compatibility/README.md) records the upgrade from DSH 0.1.7-rc.2 to 0.2.1-alpha.2, official installation and Web checks, and new real DeepSeek Flash / Jev tasks. The original package was rejected by the new installer's version checks; this revision updates the dependencies and affected public APIs. The report separates real tasks, seeded completion diagnostics, fixed lifecycle tests, and untested provider channels.

@dsh-jev/plugin README · deepseek-harness-jev：The [2026-10-11 version compatibility report](docs/testing/2026-10-11-harness-version-compatibility/README.md) checks the current plugin on four older DSH releases and 0.2.1-alpha.2. It records official installation, nine Host components, native tools and local deterministic judgment flows, plus browser checks on the oldest release, 0.2.0-rc.2 and 0.2.1-alpha.2. These checks establish version integration in the tested environment, not judgment-model quality.

@dsh-jev/plugin README · deepseek-harness-jev：The [2026-10-21 Harness compatibility report](docs/testing/2026-10-21-harness-compatibility/README.md) covers the DSH **0.2.1-rc.2** upgrade. This run checks the official package, Host components and Web integration with deterministic local model replies; no live model service is called. Earlier reports retain their original versions and experiment conditions.
@dsh-jev/plugin README · What is included?：The plugin provides the following features. **Every feature is independently disabled by default.** Installing the package does not enable them.

@dsh-jev/plugin README · What is included?：| Feature | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Skill selection | Recommends up to the configured number of skills whose relevance probability reaches the minimum; a successful judgment can recommend none. The main agent still loads the original skill. |
| File ranking | Ranks the original `glob` path results without another filesystem scan or file-content read. |
| Drift reminders | Checks progress between model steps and can deliver one nonblocking reminder. |
| Completion checks | Checks the current turn's requirements, latest Todo and final answer, with at most 3 automatic supplements by default. |
| Goal supervision | Checks native goal completion and pauses after a configurable run of rounds without progress. |
| Instruction guidance | Reads current user instructions and applicable agent rules, then supplies a nonblocking reminder when needed. |
| Interjection routing | Chooses later work, a current-task addition, or immediate model-response interruption followed by same-turn continuation. |
| Shared-finding corrections | Compares reports and messages already shared, then sends corrections to affected recipients. |
| Long-log admission |

@dsh-jev/plugin README · What is included?：*Example feature settings from an earlier build. The screenshot shows nine switches and user-selected states; current `main` includes the twelve features listed above, all disabled on a fresh installation.*

@dsh-jev/plugin README · What is included?：Interjection routing requires a Host with the public `Agent.interruptResponse()` capability. The unpatched published DSH 0.2.2-alpha.2 package does not provide it. Keep routing off on Hosts without that capability; enabling it reports an explicit Host-capability error before classification. The local source integration uses the matching DSH source change, not a published-release capability claim.

@dsh-jev/plugin README · What is included?：All features share a connection, profile-scoped settings, decision records, and operation receipts. Most agent-facing features target live Web root sessions; correcting a child agent does not enable every feature inside that child.

@dsh-jev/plugin README · What is included?：Interjection routing limits task, Goal, recent assistant and tool text to the plugin row's shared `contextChars` budget (12,000 by default). Current user requirements take priority; selected requirements retain their original order. The current message has a separate `messageChars` limit; original Session history is retained.

@dsh-jev/plugin README · What is included?：**Feature branches are not all included in `main`.** Tool-output filtering is included in `main`; `codex/jev-tool-output-admission` preserves its development snapshot. Native web execution is on `codex/jev-native-web-execution` and is **paused; ordinary-site effectiveness has not passed acceptance**. Historical split branches preserve earlier work. See [branch status](docs/branches.md) before switching branches.

@dsh-jev/plugin README · Completion checks：An enabled ordinary root turn is checked at its normal stopping point only if it used Todo during that turn. Pending items and a later empty list still qualify. A turn without Todo skips the check, and a Todo update during execution does not start a check. Native Goal turns retain their own supervision.

@dsh-jev/plugin README · Completion checks：The judgment receives the current turn's original user request and later adjustments, the complete latest Todo, and the latest final answer. It excludes raw tool results, reasoning and earlier turns. A new turn saying only “continue” does not automatically import the previous task. While the feature is enabled, a short model instruction asks for actual actions, paths, commands and observed results in existing Todo content; it adds no Todo fields or requirement to create a list for a simple task.

@dsh-jev/plugin README · Completion checks：One judgment request asks two Choice questions: `assessment` chooses `complete`, `omission`, `contradiction`, `needs-user` or `unknown`; `focus` selects an existing requirement, Todo item or final-answer reference. `complete` means the supplied report appears to meet the requirements. It does not independently verify code, artifacts or execution facts. Each check identifies only the most important issue.

@dsh-jev/plugin README · Completion checks：`omission`, `contradiction` and valid `unknown` share the profile's **Maximum automatic supplement rounds** setting (`maxSupplementRounds`), default 3. The initial check is separate: a limit of N permits at most N automatic supplements and N+1 normal checks; the default permits 3 supplements and 4 normal checks. `complete` ends normally, `needs-user` stops for the user's decision, and an unresolved result at the limit ends with that last conclusion. Supplements stay in the same turn and retain existing authorization.

@dsh-jev/plugin README · Completion checks：The full input is checked against the existing character budget before dispatch. Oversized input is neither cropped nor automatically summarized. Missing original requirements, budget rejection, transport errors or invalid answers show that the completion check did not finish and wait for **Retry / Cancel**, while retaining the main answer. Retry reads current materials and saved settings. Technical retries do not count toward N+1 normal checks and neither consume nor reset supplement rounds already used. Cancel ends the check without declaring the task successful or failed. See the [package reference](packages/jev/README.md#ordinary-completion-checks) for result meanings, records and lifecycle details.

@dsh-jev/plugin README · Completion checks：The Chinese [completion-check flow guide](https://luobosibing2.github.io/dsh-jev-plugin/explainers/jev-completion-flow.html) shows the Todo trigger, two-question judgment, supplement loop and failure handling. Its [Markdown source](docs/explainers/jev-completion-flow.md) is maintained with the implementation.

@dsh-jev/plugin README · Stage navigation：The **Stage navigation** tab follows Trajectory in the Web client. It reads recorded turns without changing the original Session.

The independent **Stage navigation** switch is off by default. It controls the tab's visibility: enabling shows the page without calling Jev, and disabling hides it, cancels unfinished classification, and retains saved results. Analysis starts only when the user selects a completed turn or requests the session's unanalyzed completed turns.

@dsh-jev/plugin README · Stage navigation：Each classification covers one complete DSH model step: its recorded reasoning, text, all tool calls, and paired results. Jev selects one of six stages, `mixed`, or `unknown`; adjacent equal labels merge only within the same turn. The page keeps a multi-turn directory beside the original steps and exposes the actual classification input and answer. Labels and confidence do not establish tool success or classification accuracy. See the [package reference](packages/jev/README.md#stage-navigation) for input, storage, and failure behavior.

@dsh-jev/plugin README · Stage navigation：Before stage analysis is sent or logged, JSON tool arguments are decoded for credential redaction and serialized again. Incomplete or invalid argument JSON is replaced with an explicit redaction marker. Original Session records remain unchanged; the revised redaction rules mark earlier classifications stale without deleting their saved records.

@dsh-jev/plugin README · Install through the Web UI (recommended)：The package declares `>=0.1.7-rc.1 <=0.2.0-rc.2 || 0.2.1-alpha.2 || 0.2.1-alpha.3 || 0.2.1-rc.2 || 0.2.1-rc.5 || 0.2.2-alpha.2`. The compatibility reports cover the eight earlier released runtimes, including 0.2.1-rc.2 and 0.2.1-rc.5. The exact 0.2.2-alpha.2 entry additionally permits the locally validated source Host; it does not make the unpatched published release capable of response interruption. Other versions, including 0.2.1-alpha.1, remain outside this declaration. Install directly from the GitHub repository URL. No source checkout, manual packaging, or npm login is required.

@dsh-jev/plugin README · Install through the Web UI (recommended)：1. Open **Plugins in the sidebar → Add plugin**.
2. Paste the GitHub URL below into **Package name or address**, then click **Install**.
3. Click **Enable now** after installation. Restart the current profile only if DSH says it will load on the next start.
4. Select **View @dsh-jev/plugin** in the installed plugin list to open its Jev page. Configure the endpoint, model, and API key, then enable the individual features you need.

```text
https://github.com/luobosibing2/deepseek-harness-jev
```

@dsh-jev/plugin README · Install through the Web UI (recommended)：*Paste the repository URL into “Package name or address”, then click Install.*

**Enabling the package does not enable its 12 Jev features; they remain off by default.** Installation applies to the Host profile serving the current Web UI. The Host needs pnpm and access to GitHub. The repository includes the plugin entry and prebuilt files, so installation does not compile source on the user's machine or require an npm registry publication.

@dsh-jev/plugin README · Install through the Web UI (recommended)：The GitHub entry provides the `main` features, not experimental branches. The older [v0.1.0 release](https://github.com/luobosibing2/deepseek-harness-jev/releases/tag/v0.1.0) does not include the newly integrated log filters. Build from source below only when changing or building the code yourself.
@dsh-jev/plugin README · Install from source (developers)：Use the following steps when modifying or building the plugin yourself. Existing DSH Web users can install using the GitHub URL above.

@dsh-jev/plugin README · Build requirements：- Node.js **24.11 or later** is recommended; the publication build is checked on Node 24.14.1.
- pnpm **11.7.0** available on `PATH`.
- Development baseline: DeepSeek Harness CLI and development packages **0.2.2-alpha.2**, with Cordis **4.0.6-alpha.1**. These exact build versions are separate from the supported installation range above. Use the explicit version below because npm's `latest` tag can point to a different release.
- A configured main-model provider in DSH, plus credentials for your selected Jev-compatible System One service or Luna API.

@dsh-jev/plugin README · Build requirements：Legacy DSH support covers installing and running the built package. Source builds and TypeScript consumers of the generated Remote declarations use the 0.2.2-alpha.2 development baseline.

If needed, install the tools:

```sh
npm install --global pnpm@11.7.0 @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.2-alpha.2
```

@dsh-jev/plugin README · Build the package：Build a `.tgz` from source, then install it through the Web UI or official CLI.

```sh
git clone https://github.com/luobosibing2/deepseek-harness-jev.git
cd deepseek-harness-jev
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm run build

On Windows, run the equivalent steps in PowerShell:

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/luobosibing2/deepseek-harness-jev.git
Set-Location deepseek-harness-jev
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm run build

@dsh-jev/plugin README · Create a separate trial profile with the CLI：You can also paste the built tarball's absolute path into an existing Web plugin manager. The CLI method below creates a separate trial environment.

Use a **new, unused profile name** for a first trial; the example uses `jev`. Initialize it from the Web template before adding the plugin:

```sh
dsh --profile jev --from-default-profile web --dump-default-config > /dev/null
dsh plugin --profile jev add ./dist/dsh-jev-plugin-0.1.0.tgz
dsh --profile jev
```

@dsh-jev/plugin README · Create a separate trial profile with the CLI：The first command creates the Web profile without launching it. Adding a plugin to a brand-new profile without this step initializes only the base configuration, not the Web application. The plugin's bundle patch is applied by the official installer; no manual host-source changes are needed.

Open the authenticated Web address printed by DSH. Configure your main model through DSH, then open the plugin's **Jev** page.
section: Create a separate trial profile with the CLI

text:
@dsh-jev/plugin README · Configure the judgment connection：1. Open **Jev → Settings and features**, then select **Jev** or **Luna Decisions** under **Judgment model**. Luna also exposes **OpenRouter** or **OpenAI** under **Luna API**.
2. Check the full request address and credential reference. Jev retains your saved custom address and model; Luna uses the fixed model for its selected API.
3. Save the connection, then save its API key through the credential control. Each connection has its own saved address and credential reference. Do not put a key in source files or a repository URL.
4. Select **Test connection** to send fixed Choice, Score, and Noul questions. A successful test means all three answers passed protocol validation; it does not establish task quality.
5. Enable only the features you need. All enabled features use the saved judgment connection; changing models does not change feature switches, thresholds, counts, or the shared timeout.
6. Inspect **Decision records** for the attempt's connection, provider-reported model, sent requests, raw provider responses, normalized answers, known usage, and action receipts.

@dsh-jev/plugin README · Configure the judgment connection：| Connection | Default full request address | Request model | Default credential reference |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Jev | Your existing System One address, for example `https://api.typesafe.ai/v1/systemone` | Your existing model, for example `jev-latest` | Your existing reference, initially `JEV_API_KEY` |
| Luna / OpenRouter | `https://openrouter.ai/api/alpha/decisions` | `openai/gpt-6-luna-decisions` | `JEV_LUNA_OPENROUTER_API_KEY` |
| Luna / OpenAI | `https://api.openai.com/v1/decisions` | `gpt-6-luna` | `JEV_LUNA_OPENAI_API_KEY` |

@dsh-jev/plugin README · Configure the judgment connection：The two Luna model IDs name the specified Luna Decisions capability in different APIs. The selected API determines the protocol, including OpenAI's `predicate` representation of Noul; editing the hostname does not change the protocol. Legal custom endpoints use that selected protocol. Switching back restores each saved connection, and old profiles default to Jev without replacing their values.

@dsh-jev/plugin README · Configure the judgment connection：Credential status shows existence and write access, never the saved key. “Configured” does not mean connectivity succeeded. Save an edited connection before changing its key or testing it; a changed connection cannot accept a stale key write or display an old diagnostic as its result. A successful key replacement clears the input. Reading, editing, or saving settings sends no model request.

@dsh-jev/plugin README · Configure the judgment connection：Requests use the connection saved when an attempt starts. A later switch applies to new attempts and explicit retries. Failures do not automatically fall back to another model or API. OpenRouter requests above 200 questions are split without dropping questions; all batches share the original timeout and complete before a business answer is delivered. Partial failures retain their actual packets and known usage. See the [package reference](packages/jev/README.md#judgment-connections) for configuration and lifecycle details.

@dsh-jev/plugin README · Configure the judgment connection：Selection defaults are at most 5 eligible skill summaries, a minimum skill relevance probability of 0.5, at most 40 glob matches eligible for ranking, and 12 displayed ranked paths. Set `skillMinProbability` on the `jev-selection` plugin row to a finite value in `[0, 1]`; a probability equal to the threshold qualifies. The Web count form preserves this setting. If no skill qualifies, a normal empty catalog lets the agent continue; `skill_catalog` recovers every model-invocable summary, and the original `skill` loader remains available by exact name. A larger glob skips judgment ranking rather than silently judging only the first 40. Supervision defaults are a drift check every 6 completed model steps, a pause after 3 native goal rounds without progress, and at most 3 automatic completion supplements. The supplement limit accepts positive safe integers and is saved in the current profile; invalid input shows an error and keeps the saved value. These independent counts can be changed without enabling the features.

@dsh-jev/plugin README · Configure the judgment connection：Long-log and test-log admission have independent switches, both off by default. Generic command logs start at 6,000 Unicode code points and recognized test logs at 4,000. The generic limit defaults to 48 eligible candidate blocks; first, last, and other retained groups do not count. With more than 48 candidates, the generic branch skips filtering at this default. Both branches share a default omit-probability threshold of 0.7; an explicit profile value takes precedence. The judgment wait limit is 4 seconds. See the [threshold evaluation](docs/reports/2026-10-17-log-admission-threshold.md) for the evidence and limits. The settings page exposes these and the other admission budgets without enabling either feature.

@dsh-jev/plugin README · Configure the judgment connection：When native Spill has a configured `maxInlineTokens`, admission first estimates the complete model-visible result with the Host's shared estimator and that execution's effective budget. A result above the budget skips both the judgment request and rule-based omissions, then continues to native Spill. A result equal to the budget may continue through the existing checks. Jev still processes the text before Spill clips it. If the policy is not loaded or its budget is unset, existing Jev admission continues without this limit; `0` is a configured budget. Any adopted replacement must also fit the budget with its omission markers, recovery hint, and outer result included. This is task-related noise removal within the native budget, not a guarantee of token savings or better task results. See the [package reference](packages/jev/README.md#tool-log-admission) for configuration changes and uncertain policy state.

@dsh-jev/plugin README · Behavior and limitations：Enabled features send the relevant task context or operation data to the configured judgment endpoint. Exact judgment inputs and answers are stored in the profile's local plugin records; model-visible effects use normal DSH session records. Keep runtime records and credentials private. Public source history excludes personal QA screenshots and raw session captures.

@dsh-jev/plugin README · Updating or removing the plugin：For an existing profile, rebuild and pack, then install the new tarball with `dsh plugin --profile jev add <new-tarball-path>` and restart that profile. Do not rerun `--from-default-profile` on an existing profile. Use a new tarball filename for a changed build of the same package version and check the installed contents when validating an update.

@dsh-jev/plugin README · Updating or removing the plugin：Disable individual features in the Jev page. For package removal, consult `dsh plugin --help` for the CLI version you have installed. Removing or switching the package can remove branch-specific features; keep a profile backup before replacing an experimental branch build.

@dsh-jev/plugin README · Development：The project is named `deepseek-harness-jev`; its internal package and import identifier remains `@dsh-jev/plugin`, matching existing profile plugin configurations.

The repository root is the GitHub install entry; `packages/jev` retains development sources. `pnpm run build` also regenerates `runtime/`; commit these generated files when releasing source changes.

@dsh-jev/plugin README · Development：[Plugin CI](.github/workflows/ci.yml) runs on pull requests and pushes to `main`, using Node 24 and the pnpm version declared in `packageManager`. It runs `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, `pnpm run typecheck`, `pnpm test`, and `pnpm run build`, then rejects changed, deleted, or new files under `runtime/`. Build and commit updated runtime files with source changes before opening a pull request.

@dsh-jev/plugin README · Development：The Client CSS build uses paths relative to the package for class-name hashes and sorts class mappings, so the runtime comparison does not depend on the checkout's absolute path or CSS export traversal order.

@dsh-jev/plugin README · Development：Protocol-reference preparation uses a directory junction on Windows, so `pnpm run typecheck` and `pnpm run build` do not require elevation or Developer Mode to create that dependency link. Other platforms retain a relative directory symlink. The preparation regression runs in both the Windows job and the standard test suite.

@dsh-jev/plugin README · Development：Run `pnpm run test:compatibility` to build and pack the official GitHub-install entry, prepare the latest DSH release in the verification target list, and check installation, Host components and the Jev Web page in a disposable profile. It enables 11 features and leaves interjection routing disabled because that feature requires the paired source Host's `Agent.interruptResponse()`. The [compatibility smoke guide](docs/testing/compatibility-smoke/README.md) covers Chromium setup, explicit version selection and supported-version updates. The check uses local deterministic model replies and needs no real model credentials.

@dsh-jev/plugin README · Development：Maintainers can use the [DeepSWE paired-evaluation runner](bench/deepswe/README.md) for coding tasks and the [glob-ranking pipeline](bench/selection/README.md) for fixed path-selection cases. Both use isolated DSH/Pier trials and keep model execution separate from offline checks and reports. The [Chinese evaluation guide](bench/deepswe/README.zh-CN.md) covers the coding-task workflow.

@dsh-jev/plugin README · Development：The [completion and skill evaluation entry](bench/completion_skill/README.md) provides four named scenarios, including `completion-recovery-16`, explicit resource manifests, new-batch preparation, keyless preflight, paid execution, and offline reports. The [new fixed diagnosis](docs/testing/2026-10-05-completion-recovery/README.md) and [historical results](docs/testing/2026-10-02-completion-skill/README.md) remain separate from validation of the maintained runner. A rerun records the runner commit and source hashes; dependencies and credentials remain local prerequisites.

@dsh-jev/plugin README · Development：The [public glob experiment](docs/testing/2026-10-01-glob-ranking/README.md) records six synthetic cases and 12 real DeepSeek/Jev trials: four successful Jev judgments returned 69 scores, while zero and 41 candidates bypassed ranking. It retains quality failures, recovery checks, source-read counts, and estimated costs. The historical run used a pinned earlier plugin artifact; the maintained pipeline does not imply the current `main` was rerun or that general task success improved.

@dsh-jev/plugin README · Development：```sh
pnpm run typecheck
pnpm run build

@dsh-jev/plugin README · 包含哪些功能？：| 功能 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| 技能选择（Skill selection） | 推荐概率达到最低值的技能，数量不超过配置上限；成功判断也可以零推荐。主 Agent 仍通过原生 skill 加载正文。 |
| 文件排序（File ranking） | 对原生 glob 返回的路径排序，不追加文件扫描或正文读取。 |
| 跑偏提醒（Drift monitoring） | 在模型步骤之间检查进展，必要时提供一次非阻塞提醒。 |
| 完成核查（Completion checks） | 核查本 turn 的要求、最新 Todo 与最终回答，默认最多自动补充 3 轮。 |
| 持续目标监督（Goal supervision） | 检查原生目标完成申请，连续多轮没有进展时暂停。 |
| 用户约束提醒（Instruction guidance） | 读取当前用户要求及适用的 Agent 规则，必要时发送非阻塞提醒。 |
| 中途插话分流（Interjection routing） | 区分后续任务、当前补充和即时纠正；即时纠正可中断模型响应，再在同一回合继续。 |
| 共享发现纠正（Shared-finding corrections） | 比较已经共享的报告和消息，向受影响的接收者发送纠正。 |
| 通用长日志准入（Tool-output filtering） | 命令返回后可省略明确不需要的进度或重复提示，并提供原文恢复位置。 |
| 测试日志准入（Test-log filtering） | 保护失败、摘要、点名和慢测试，再判断普通通过明细是否仍有用。 |
| 工作区提权代审批（Workspace approval） | 仅在 workspace-write 下参与适用的原生单次提权；非肯定判断回到原人工审批。 |
| 阶段导航（Stage navigation） | 按需分类已记录的完整模型步骤，将连续阶段与轨迹原文关联。 |

@dsh-jev/plugin README · 包含哪些功能？：*较早版本的功能设置示例。截图展示 9 个开关及用户自行选择的状态；当前 `main` 包含上表中的 12 项功能，新安装时默认全部关闭。*

所有功能共用连接、按 profile 保存的设置、判断记录与操作回执。多数 Agent 功能面向存活的 Web 主会话；向子 Agent 发送纠正，不等于子 Agent 自动拥有其他 Jev 增强。

中途插话分流让任务、Goal、近期助手正文和工具文本共用插件组件的 `contextChars` 预算（默认 12,000 字符）。当前用户要求优先保留，选中的要求按原始顺序呈现。当前消息另用 `messageChars` 限制；原始 Session 历史仍保留。

**功能分支不等于已合入 main。** 工具输出筛选已进入 `main`；`codex/jev-tool-output-admission` 保留开发快照。原生网页执行在 `codex/jev-native-web-execution`，该方向目前**暂停，普通网站效果未通过验收**。其他历史分支保留早期实现。切换前请看[分支状态](docs/branches.md)。
@dsh-jev/plugin README · 包含哪些功能？：插话分流要求 Host 提供公开的 `Agent.interruptResponse()` 能力。未打本功能补丁的已发布 DSH 0.2.2-alpha.2 不具备该能力。在缺少能力的 Host 上保持分流关闭；开启后会在分类前明确报告 Host 能力不足。本地源码联动使用配套 DSH 源码改动，不代表该能力已包含在发布包中。

@dsh-jev/plugin README · 完成核查：`omission`、`contradiction` 与有效 `unknown` 共用当前 profile 的**最多自动补充轮数**（`maxSupplementRounds`），默认 3。初次核查另算：上限 N 允许最多 N 次自动补充、N+1 次正常核查；默认最多 3 次补充、4 次正常核查。`complete` 正常结束，`needs-user` 交用户决定，额度耗尽仍有问题则显示最后结论并停止。补充仍在同一 turn，遵守已有授权。

发送前按现有字符预算检查完整输入；超长不裁剪、不自动摘要。原始要求缺失、预算拒绝、接口错误或无效答案会提示本次完成核查未完成，保留主模型回答并等待 **Retry / Cancel（重试 / 取消）**。重试读取当前材料与已保存设置；技术重试不计入 N+1 次正常核查，也不消耗或重置已使用的补充轮数。取消只结束核查，不将任务判为成功或失败。结论、记录与生命周期详情见[包参考](packages/jev/README.md#ordinary-completion-checks)。

@dsh-jev/plugin README · 完成核查：[完成核查流程导读](https://luobosibing2.github.io/dsh-jev-plugin/explainers/jev-completion-flow.html)展示 Todo 触发、两个判断问题、补充循环和失败处理。[Markdown 源稿](docs/explainers/jev-completion-flow.md)随实现维护。
@dsh-jev/plugin README · 阶段导航：阶段分析发送或写入日志前，先解码 JSON 工具参数、脱敏凭据，再重新序列化。不完整或无效的参数 JSON 会替换为明确的脱敏标记。原始 Session 记录保持不变；更新后的脱敏规则使先前分类显示为过期，但不会删除已保存记录。

@dsh-jev/plugin README · 配置判断连接：1. 打开 **Jev → 设置与功能**，在**判断模型**中选择 **Jev** 或 **Luna Decisions**；Luna 还可在 **Luna API** 中选择 **OpenRouter** 或 **OpenAI**。
2. 检查完整请求地址和凭据引用。Jev 保留原自定义地址和模型；Luna 使用对应 API 的固定模型标识。
3. 保存连接，再通过凭据控件保存 API Key。每套连接分别保存地址和凭据引用，不要把密钥写入源码或仓库 URL。
4. 点击**测试连接**，发送固定 Choice、Score、Noul 问题。通过表示三类回答均完成协议校验，不表示实际任务判断质量。
5. 只开启需要的功能。所有已启用功能使用已保存判断连接；切换模型不会改变功能开关、阈值、数量参数或共用超时。
6. 在**判断记录**中核对本次连接、提供方返回模型、实际请求、原始响应、统一答案、已知用量和动作回执。

@dsh-jev/plugin README · 配置判断连接：选择功能默认最多推荐 5 个合格技能摘要，最低相关概率为 0.5；最多对 40 个 glob 命中排序，展示 12 条路径。在 `jev-selection` 插件行配置 `skillMinProbability`，取值须为 `[0, 1]` 内的有限数，概率恰等于阈值也合格。Web 数量表单保存时保留该阈值。没有技能合格时，正常发布空目录，主 Agent 可继续任务；`skill_catalog` 可恢复全部可供模型调用的摘要，原生 `skill` 仍可按准确名称加载。glob 超过上限时直接跳过判断排序，不会悄悄只判断前 40 个。监督功能默认每 6 个完成的模型步骤检查一次跑偏，连续 3 个原生目标轮次无进展则暂停；完成核查默认最多自动补充 3 轮。补充轮数接受正安全整数，按当前 profile 保存；非法输入显示错误并保留已保存值。这些计数互相独立，保存参数不会自动开启功能。

@dsh-jev/plugin README · 配置判断连接：通用长日志准入和测试日志准入有独立开关，均默认关闭。命令日志从 6,000 个 Unicode 码点、可识别测试日志从 4,000 个码点开始处理。通用分支默认最多允许 48 个可判断候选块；首尾及其他保留分组不计入名额。默认设置下，候选超过 48 个时放弃本次通用过滤。两分支共用默认省略概率门槛 0.7，profile 显式配置值优先。判断最多等待 4 秒。取值依据和限制见[阈值评估](docs/reports/2026-10-17-log-admission-threshold.zh-CN.md)。设置页可调整这些及其他准入预算，保存预算不会开启功能。

@dsh-jev/plugin README · 配置判断连接：原生 Spill 配置了 `maxInlineTokens` 时，准入先用宿主共享估算器和本次执行实际生效的预算，检查整个模型可见结果。超过预算就跳过判断请求及规则省略，原样交给原生 Spill；等于预算可继续接受已有检查。Jev 的文本处理位置仍在 Spill 裁剪之前。策略未加载或未配置预算时，沿用现有 Jev 处理，不增加这项限制；`0` 仍是有效预算。采用结果也必须在计入省略标记、恢复提示和外层结果后符合预算。这项功能用于原生预算内的任务相关性去噪，不保证真实 token 节省或任务收益。配置变化及策略状态无法确定时的行为见[包参考](packages/jev/README.md#tool-log-admission)。

@dsh-jev/plugin README · 行为与限制：- **提醒是建议。** 跑偏和约束提醒不会阻塞、取消工具，也不会强制主模型遵守。即使只有一个引用或没有文字要求，证据选择题也至少保留两个选项；不确定选项不能作为纠正提醒的依据。
- **完成核查的固定16槽诊断。** 初始错误由脚本种入，开启组的6/6个错误案例经真实Jev判断和DeepSeek补做满足核心要求；2/2个准确对照判为完成，均无补做。见[新诊断结果](docs/testing/2026-10-05-completion-recovery/public-results.zh-CN.md)。这些试次使用此前的已有证据核查语义，不能证明轻量报告核查的真实任务效果，也不能推出自然任务错误率或编码平均收益。历史长编码试次因默认证据预算裁掉原始要求，判断零采用、零自动补做，最终转入人工Retry/Cancel，见[旧报告](docs/testing/2026-10-02-completion-skill/README.md)。
- **审批只针对一次操作。** 不改变会话沙箱模式，不覆盖宿主固定检查。操作路径和直接脚本证据使用原生当前工作目录，包含相对 shell `workdir` 覆盖；原始工作区仍为沙箱边界。有效 approve 可返回 allowed-once，unauthorized 或 unknown 回原人工审批；技术故障保留人工 Retry/Cancel。
- **共享纠正有明确范围。** 它只处理已经共享的报告和消息，不读取所有 Agent 的内部探索；自动投递限当前存活的主 Agent 及其活跃、可继续的直接子 Agent。同一发现以不同形式上报时，仍可能产生重复纠正。
- **插话判断使用原始事实。** 分流发送新消息、有界的原始任务及修改要求、可用 Goal、近期助手正文、必要工具事实和代码确定的执行阶段。准备输入不调用摘要模型；稳定消息正常只分类一次。响应中断不会取消已经启动的工具。
- **判断成功不等于执行成功。** 日志分别记录判断、采纳、许可发放和实际操作结果。
- **日志准入保留原文入口。** 它只在工具执行后调整符合条件的模型可见文本；DSH 即时 spill、工具输出上限和之后的上下文压缩仍生效。隔离真实 profile 的一次构建将 8,510 字符日志缩短了 75.7%。一次中性措辞的 180 项测试触发了测试日志判断，但省略概率低于当时配置的 0.8 门槛，因此完整保留；该次不证明测试日志已有实际缩减效果。见[工具输出准入报告](docs/reports/2026-09-27-tool-output-admission.zh-CN.md)。
- **验证有范围。** 确定性测试证明集成流程，有限真实样例不能证明普遍语义准确率。详见[验证说明](d
@dsh-jev/plugin README · 行为与限制：开启的功能会将相关任务上下文或操作内容发送到配置的判断服务。精确判断输入和回答保存在 profile 的本地插件记录中，主模型可见影响使用正常 DSH Session 记录。运行资料和凭据应保留为私有数据；公开源码历史不包含个人 QA 截图和原始会话抓取。

@dsh-jev/plugin README · 更新与移除：已有 profile 更新时，重新构建、打包，运行 `dsh plugin --profile jev add <新安装包路径>`，再重启该 profile。不要对已有 profile 重新执行 `--from-default-profile`。相同版本号的不同构建使用新的安装包文件名，验收更新时核对实际安装内容。

单项功能可在 Jev 页面关闭。移除整个包时，以当前 CLI 的 `dsh plugin --help` 为准。替换实验分支安装包可能移除该分支特有功能，替换前保留 profile 备份。

@dsh-jev/plugin README · 开发：Client CSS 构建用包内相对路径计算类名哈希，并对类名映射排序，使 runtime 比较不依赖 checkout 的绝对路径或 CSS 导出字段的遍历顺序。

协议参考准备步骤在 Windows 上使用目录联接（junction），因此 `pnpm run typecheck` 和 `pnpm run build` 创建该依赖链接时无需管理员权限或开发者模式。其他平台仍使用相对目录符号链接。该准备步骤的回归检查在 Windows CI 作业和常规测试套件中运行。

@dsh-jev/plugin README · 开发：运行 `pnpm run test:compatibility`，即可构建并打包正式 GitHub 安装入口、准备验证目标列表中最新的 DSH 发布版本，并在临时 profile 中检查官方安装、Host 组件和 Jev 网页。检查启用其余 11 项功能；中途插话分流保持关闭，因为它需要配套源码 Host 的 `Agent.interruptResponse()`。[兼容性 smoke 指南](docs/testing/compatibility-smoke/README.md)说明 Chromium 准备、指定版本及更新支持版本的方法。检查使用本地确定性模型回复，无需真实模型凭据。

维护者可用 [DeepSWE 配对评测入口](bench/deepswe/README.zh-CN.md)评测编码任务，用 [glob 排序管线](bench/selection/README.zh-CN.md)验证固定路径选择案例。两者采用隔离的 DSH/Pier trial，将模型执行与离线检查、报告分开。[英文评测指南](bench/deepswe/README.md)提供编码任务工作流。

@dsh-jev/plugin README · 开发：[完成核查与技能评测入口](bench/completion_skill/README.zh-CN.md)提供四个具名场景，包括`completion-recovery-16`，以及显式资源清单、新批次准备、无费预检、收费执行和离线报告。[新固定诊断](docs/testing/2026-10-05-completion-recovery/README.md)与[历史结果](docs/testing/2026-10-02-completion-skill/README.md)均和维护入口的验证分开。每次重跑记录脚本提交和源码哈希，依赖及凭据仍需在运行机器上可用。

[公开 glob 实验](docs/testing/2026-10-01-glob-ranking/README.md)记录六类合成案例与12次真实DeepSeek/Jev运行：4次成功Jev判断返回69项分数，0和41候选按规则旁路；报告保留质量负例、恢复检查、源码读取数与费用估算。历史运行使用固定的旧版插件产物，维护中的管线不表示当前main已重跑，也不表示通用任务成功率提高。
